source: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive (free, no API key)
note: ERA5 reanalysis interpolated to the point; independent of NASA POWER. Daily values aggregated to monthly means, maxima or totals. Wind is converted from km/h to m/s, radiation from MJ/m²/day to kWh/m²/day, sunshine from seconds to hours, and snowfall is reported in cm.
